objective: Find simple interpretable nonlinear cross-sectional formulas that improve future ETF relative-return ranking beyond momentum and the validated share-flow-plus-momentum ensemble.
point_in_time_rule: All input features are constructed only from facts available by the tested close. ETF share facts for trading day T are shifted to become available from T+1 trading day. Training rows are purged unless their forward label is fully realized by train_end. Test outcomes must be realized no later than data_end.
complexity_boundary: Formula search is intentionally constrained. No ETF code, price level, instrument identity, future information, lifecycle decision, trade result or post-hoc feature selection is allowed as an input.
